description: Land Title Settlement Department - Enamaluwa, Dambulla D/S Division, Matale District - Cad. Map No. 310009
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, ownership details, extent of land, and other land-related particulars. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
